description: This file implements a service for managing mesh gateway Virtual Access Points (VAPs) in a WiFi network. It includes functions to start, stop, update, and check if a VAP is a mesh backhaul gateway, utilizing lower-level HAL functions and WiFi utility functions. It interacts with VAP configurations, handles memory allocation, and performs VAP creation and configuration updates.

methods.name: bool vap_svc_is_mesh_gw(unsigned int vap_index)
methods.description: Checks if the specified VAP index corresponds to a mesh backhaul gateway.

methods.name: int vap_svc_mesh_gw_start(vap_svc_t * svc,unsigned int radio_index,wifi_vap_info_map_t * map)
methods.description: Starts the mesh gateway VAPs on a given radio interface.

methods.name: int vap_svc_mesh_gw_stop(vap_svc_t * svc,unsigned int radio_index,wifi_vap_info_map_t * map)
methods.description: Stops the mesh gateway VAPs on a given radio interface.

methods.name: int vap_svc_mesh_gw_update(vap_svc_t * svc,unsigned int radio_index,wifi_vap_info_map_t * map,rdk_wifi_vap_info_t * rdk_vap_info)
methods.description: Updates VAP configurations for the mesh gateway, creating VAPs as needed and updating related configuration objects.

methods.name: int vap_svc_mesh_gw_event(vap_svc_t * svc,wifi_event_type_t type,wifi_event_subtype_t sub_type,vap_svc_event_t event,void * arg)
methods.description: Handles events related to the mesh gateway, currently implemented as a stub.
